title: Explicit existing Linux Knowledge CPU manufacturing inputs

source_root.description: Manufacturer-owned existing canonical source directory; must equal the actual factory source root. Required absolute path with no aliases/group writes. Read only; change requires a new process and receipt.

state_root.description: Required exclusive existing0700 manufacturer state directory for new outputs/context/receipts. No credentials or customer data. Change requires new process; never a substitute mount.

runtime_tmp.description: Required existing0700 durable scratch strictly below state_root. Maps only to child TMPDIR; GOTMPDIR and loader/credential environment are absent. Change requires new process.

docker_binary.description: Required canonical existing executable Docker CLI; reused read only with exact file identity. It selects only the existing local Unix context/Engine, never downloads or changes daemon configuration.

python_binary.description: Required canonical existing executable manufacturer Python, equal to the current interpreter after resolving its invocation. This is not the runtime-version authority: actual target Python is the pinned image. Reused read only; no host installation.

preflight_script.description: Required canonical owned single-link existing executable Linux admission script. Runs with sanitized PATH/LANG before allocation. No secrets or interpolation; change requires a new process/receipt.

format_version.description: Fixed input protocol version; not a deployment toggle.

kind.description: Fixed typed manufacturer boundary. It never patches workstation Settings.

input_roots.description: Required explicit existing canonical protected roots for read-only public wheels/model/installer/receipt inputs. Root filesystem is forbidden. No secret references or implicit search; change requires a new process.

peak_memory_bytes.description: Required total admitted peak bytes including selector/runtime and manufacturer coexistence; must cover policy.memory_bytes. Preserve30percent host headroom, and separately coordinate aggregate Engine consumers. No default; change requires new admission/process.

build_seconds.description: Maximum foreground image/archive operation wall seconds; default runtimes/knowledge/runtime.json manufacturing.build_seconds. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

import_seconds.description: Maximum actual installed CPU probe wall seconds; default current runtime manufacturing.import_seconds. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

threads.description: Positive CPU/thread count for current runtime probe; default current runtime manufacturing.threads. Must fit actual process affinity; selector stays at1CPU. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

maximum_log_bytes.description: Maximum retained log bytes per operation; default current runtime manufacturing.maximum_log_bytes. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

memory_bytes.description: Runtime-probe memory limit in bytes; default current runtime manufacturing.memory_bytes. Must not exceed peak_memory_bytes; offline selector independently uses1GiB. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

pids_limit.description: Runtime-probe process count limit; default current runtime manufacturing.pids_limit. Selector independently uses128. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

stop_seconds.description: Owned process/container normal-stop grace seconds; default current runtime manufacturing.stop_seconds. Uncertain state remains retained. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

docker_operation_timeout_seconds.description: Bounded metadata/CLI operation seconds; default15. Container stop adds its explicit stop grace. No daemon timeout change. Optional override through this input only; booleans are rejected. No secrets. Effective values are recorded; change requires a fresh process/receipt.

policy.description: Required object, may be empty to inherit original named runtime defaults. Overrides affect manufacturer children only, not customer runtime configuration or artifact pins.

role.description: Each role exactly once; all allocated peaks sharing a physical device are summed. Context includes formal copied wheels/licenses/cache/staging; evidence includes retained archives/failed outputs.

path.description: Existing canonical allocation path. Source/context/runtime/evidence must match the respective selected path; docker must match actual local DockerRootDir.

storage_role.description: Explicit actual storage role; internal retains max30percent/fixed reserve, external needs a genuinely distinct nonroot mount/device. No tmpfs runtime or fake external directory.

mount_root.description: Actual existing kernel mount root, checked by findmnt/device identity. Not a pathname alias.

mount_source.description: Exact actual kernel mount source from findmnt. No secret or interpolation; mismatch refuses.

filesystem.description: Actual durable Linux filesystem reported by the live kernel; runtime tmpfs/overlay is refused.

peak_additional_bytes.description: Required projected additional peak bytes including coexistence for this role. No boolean, zero or unverified cleanup credit. Re-admitted before substantive operations.

safety_reserve_bytes.description: Required fixed reserve bytes, at least32GiB; internal also retains30percent total. Same-device roles use the maximum reserve, not repeated reserve sums.

resource_plan.description: Required complete explicit plan; exact allocation identity and real disk capacity checked before effects. A wheel-only preparation uses its own smaller honest peaks, not a future image approval.

description: Public path/budget input carried by --manufacturing-environment. The input file must be0600/single-link/owned with an existing0700 parent. No env interpolation, secrets, global settings, network downloads or arbitrary source variants. Every change requires fresh admission and a new receipt; no customer artifact rebuild is needed just to select deployment policy.
